responsibility: This definition module declares a minimal assertion facility for the gm2 base libraries. It exports a single Assert procedure that belongs to the runtime diagnostics layer and specifies the stable contract that failed boolean conditions terminate execution, providing a lightweight check interface reused by other support modules.
same_name_distinction: Definition half of the Assertion pair: it only exposes the Assert procedure contract, whereas Assertion.mod contains the failure handling that writes an error message and halts.
